name: marquee-track
purpose: Provides a bounded, observer- or control-driven horizontal track advance without autonomous looping.

cwvImpact.rationale: A host-controlled transform moves the track once per state change; it does not animate geometry or repeat autonomously.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: The track remains in its readable resting position with animation and transition disabled.

cwvTripwire.layoutShift: Only transform is transitioned; the track retains its layout dimensions.
cwvTripwire.longAnimation: A discrete state change is capped at --dur-3 and no autonomous loop is allowed.
